meta.title: Download PromptBox — Windows / macOS
meta.description: Download PromptBox v3.10.0 free for Windows 10/11 and macOS 12+ (Apple Silicon). Windows installer and portable builds plus a macOS disk image, encrypted local storage, 100% offline.

hero.lead: Free to start. Every installer is published here on this site with a SHA-256 checksum you can verify yourself — encrypted locally, 100% offline.

desktopOnly.note: PromptBox is a desktop app for Windows and macOS — it cannot be installed on a phone or tablet, so there is no download button here. If you are on a computer, widen the browser window and the button will appear.
desktopOnly.cardNote: Phones and tablets cannot install it. Open this page on a computer, or widen the window, to download.

trust.t4: Manual updates · fully under your control

platforms.title: Choose your operating system
platforms.lead: Windows installer and portable builds (offline-friendly, custom install directory), plus a macOS build for Apple Silicon.

win.body: A standard install wizard (with a choice of drive) plus a portable build that needs no installation. Settings live in an isolated local directory.

mac.body: Native build for Apple Silicon (M1 and later), with the database key held by the macOS Keychain. There is no Intel Mac build yet.
mac.f2: Apple Silicon (arm64) only — will not run on Intel Macs
mac.f3: Key held by the macOS Keychain

checksum.title: File checksums (SHA-256)

s1.title: Download and install
s1.body: Grab the installer for your OS from this page and follow the wizard — about 30 seconds.

s2.title: First launch
s2.body: PromptBox creates the encrypted database (SQLite + ChaCha20) and loads a set of example cards, so you can explore without breaking anything.

s3.title: Copy your first prompt
s3.body: Click a card to copy it, paste straight into ChatGPT / Claude / your IDE, and stop keeping prompts in your head.

n1.title: How updates work, and the zero-outbound guarantee
n1.body: PromptBox has been fully offline since v3.3.0. Every automatic update check and background connection has been removed from the app; new versions are announced by email and downloaded manually from this site, then installed over the old one (the install path doesn’t change and your data stays exactly where it is). The one networked component is the built-in MCP server: it listens on 127.0.0.1 only, so the IDEs on your own machine can connect to it, and it never reaches outward.

n2.title: Local data encryption
n2.body: A database encrypted as a whole with SQLite + ChaCha20 is created on first launch. The key is held by your operating system's secure keychain (Windows DPAPI / macOS Keychain) and never written to disk in plaintext.

n4.title: Windows may show an “unrecognised app” prompt
n4.bodyPre: That prompt is accurate: we have not bought a code signing certificate yet, so Windows cannot match the installer to a verified publisher. We will not ask you to ignore it — check the file against the SHA-256 checksum above, and read
n4.linkLabel: why there is no signature yet
n4.bodyPost: for the reasoning, how to verify us yourself, and when this goes away.

n5.title: macOS will block the first launch
n5.bodyPre: This is accurate too: we don’t have an Apple Developer account yet, so the macOS build has no Apple-issued developer signature and has not been notarized, and macOS cannot confirm where it came from. We won’t ask you to ignore that either — check the .dmg against the SHA-256 checksum above, then read
n5.linkLabel: the macOS section of the manual
n5.bodyPost: before deciding whether to open it. Also, whether your data carries over intact when you install a new version over the old one has not been tested on a Mac yet; until it has, don’t let PromptBox on your Mac hold the only copy of anything important.
